route: PicoGK STL -> pymeshlab decimate 40k -> manifold3d watertight -> decimate 1800 (topology-preserving, re-manifolded) -> per-triangle planar B-Rep faces -> shell -> STEP AP214
limits: faceted B-Rep: each mesh triangle is a planar face, no surface fitting; tessellation fidelity governed by decimation. Shell, not solid: single shell per watertight mesh but OCC did not seal into solid. Research geometry: not fitted, not released.
note: FreeCAD 1.1.3 on this host lacks a mesh->shape converter (MeshPart has no shapeFromMesh); gmsh/OCC parametrization refuses these topologies (poincare/genus). cadquery-ocp route used instead — honest, deterministic, proven by readback.
